label: setup
js: (() => { document.querySelector('#hud .title').style.display = 'none'; document.querySelector('#hud').style.display = 'none'; window.__view = (px, py, pz, lx, ly, lz, mm) => { const r = __kk.rig; const P = r.cam.position.clone().set(px, py, pz), L = r.cam.position.clone().set(lx, ly, lz); r.presets[9] = { name: 'view', pos: () => P.clone(), look: () => L.clone(), mm, dof: 0, focus: () => 10 }; __kk.preset(9); }; __kk.rig.handheldAmount = 0; __kk.teleport('kitten', 1.2, -3.2, Math.PI); __kk.teleport('knight', -0.4, -2.6, Math.PI); return 'ok'; })()
